description: This file contains implementation of the 'em_configuration' class and associated functions, primarily dealing with generating, sending, and handling topology, configuration, and device status messages in a Wi-Fi mesh network context. It includes functions to create various TLVs (Type-Length-Value structures), compose complex messages, perform validation, and process topology notifications and responses. The code interfaces with other components such as data models, message validators, and socket send functions, and handles intricate Wi-Fi mesh-specific data structures and protocol logic.

classes.name: em_configuration_t
classes.description: Implements methods to generate, send, and process various Wi-Fi mesh topology and configuration messages, including creation of TLVs, message validation, and handling received messages, specifically tailored for managing and reporting topology and device state in a Wi-Fi mesh network.

methods.name: unsigned short create_client_assoc_event_tlv(unsigned char * buff,mac_address_t sta,bssid_t bssid,bool assoc)
methods.description: Constructs a TLV containing client association event details, including MAC addresses and BSSID, for topology notifications.

methods.name: send_topology_notification_by_client
methods.description: Creates and sends a topology notification message indicating a client's association or disassociation with a BSSID.

methods.name: int handle_topology_notification(unsigned char * buff,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Processes topology notification messages, updating internal state and possibly triggering reports or other actions based on client association events.

methods.name: handle_topology_response
methods.description: Processes topology response messages, updating internal data structures like operational BSS info, profiles, and configurations based on received TLVs.

methods.name: int create_operational_bss_tlv(unsigned char * buff)
methods.description: Builds a TLV representing the current operational BSSs, including SSID, BSSID, and radio info for topology reports.
